name: Walker S
summary: UBTECH's industrial humanoid line, aimed squarely at car factories: Walker S and S1 have run training pilots on assembly and inspection lines at BYD, Nio, Zeekr and a Foxconn plant. The 2025 Walker S2 can walk to a station and swap its own depleted battery pack to keep working across shifts.
notable: Multiple automaker factory pilots in China
Walker S2 performs autonomous battery hot-swaps
